I am a behavioural neuroscientist and an Assistant Researcher at **CONICET**. I
teach at **Universidad de San Andrés** and work on data science at
**[DwiD](https://github.com/DwiD-DS)**. I live and work in Buenos Aires,
Argentina.

I study how the brain organises time — from the perception of millisecond
intervals to circadian rhythms and sleep. Along the way I write a fair amount of
R, and much of my work is about bringing sound statistical methods into the
everyday practice of the behavioural sciences.
